content.text: I'm figuring out the rule: check if the right half mirrors the left half, and if not, clear it out. Now I need a test input to verify this pattern.

Since the color and position differ here, this looks like a clear case. But I wonder if the rule only compares shape - in the earlier example shapes differed, while here the shape stays the same but color and position change. Still, I lean toward this being clear.
